Headline results for run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (read-only report; no PBS jobs submitted, hazard.py not run):

SCOPE
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20), covering 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z (3.314% of the March 2016 window).
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57.
- DAS detections: 62 detections in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 detections above the catalogue completeness magnitude Mc).
- Pumping: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days (net extraction).
- Catalogue: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07 (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016).

CALIBRATED PROBABILITIES (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5; the LBNL/NCEDC catalogue is the calibrated one):
- b = 1.0: Sigma = -5.449, P(Mw >= 5.5)/yr = 0.0001198, P(Mw >= 5.5) over the observed volume = 5.236e-06, P(M >= 3)/yr = 0.03719
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.319, P(Mw >= 5.5)/yr = 0.004922, P(Mw >= 5.5) over the observed volume = 0.0002155, P(M >= 3)/yr = 0.2809
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.281, P(Mw >= 5.5)/yr = 0.01474, P(Mw >= 5.5) over the observed volume = 0.0006484, P(M >= 3)/yr = 0.4653

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (uncalibrated magnitudes; every DAS detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts):
- b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(Mw >= 5.5)/yr = 0.07842

INTERPRETATION
- The calibrated result is the catalogue-based (LBNL/NCEDC) probability: even at the most favourable b = 0.65, P(Mw >= 5.5) is ~1.5e-2 per year (and ~6.5e-4 over the observed injection volume), i.e. a Pohang-like Mw >= 5.5 event is unlikely in this window.
- The DAS-based number (P = 0.07842/yr at b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698) is an upper bound only: its magnitudes are uncalibrated and it counts all 62 DAS detections as events above Mc, so it systematically over-counts. The true calibrated probability lies at or below the catalogue-based values.
